cli.usage:
Fav Session Manager — all your Claude Code / Codex sessions: favorite, search, resume in one keystroke

  fav                       default UI (FAV_UI=fzf|tui)
  fav tui | fav fzf         pick a front end
  fav add                   read the JSON produced by the /fav skill from stdin
  fav list [query]          list favorites (--json / --line)
  fav sessions [query]      list every session on this machine, favorited or not (--json)
  fav grep <keywords> [query]  search the messages of every session; filter tokens pick which (--json / --limit)
  fav show <id>             one record (--json)
  fav preview <id>          render the preview block
  fav open <id>             the TUI on one session, right pane focused (also sessions the lists hide)
  fav status <id> todo|doing|done
  fav done <id>             = status done
  fav archive|unarchive <id>
  fav fav|unfav <id>        favorite / unfavorite (record kept)
  fav pin|unpin <id>        keep the transcript with a hard link
  fav edit <id>             edit title / tags / summary in $EDITOR
  fav rm <id|session id>    move a session's files to the trash (-y skips the prompt) (alias: delete)
  fav trash                 list the trash (--json; --restore <id|session id>; --purge drops expired, --purge --all empties it after a prompt, -y skips)
  fav mv <old dir> <new dir>  move a project: rewrite cwd in its sessions (-y skips the prompt) (alias: move)
  fav fix [dir] [query] [n…]   sessions whose directory moved: list (default), move with numbers / session ids / all (--to picks the target)
  fav clean [dir] [query] [n…] unrecoverable sessions: list (default), trash with numbers / session ids / all
  fav resume <id>           resume (--dry-run / --no-herdr; --fork starts a copy)
  fav handoff <id>          print a handoff pack for a new session (--to claude|codex starts one that reads it)
  fav today | fav week        what you worked on, by project: sessions, files written, commits (--json; a query narrows it)
  fav doctor                health check (--compact compacts the data file)
  fav hosts                 the configured machines and when their lists were last fetched
  fav hosts check [host…]   probe each machine: ssh, fav version, CLIs, CJK round trip, read speed (--timeout)
  fav hosts add <name> <ssh alias>  add a machine (--fav path, --wsl distro | --docker container, --shell), then check it
  fav hosts rm <name…>      remove machines and their cached lists
  fav hosts install <host>  build fav from this checkout and install it there, in WSL or a container too (--os / --arch / --src / --dry-run)
  fav hosts clear [host…]   forget cached lists (all hosts by default)
  fav rpc                   answer one protocol request from stdin (--stdio: until stdin closes); run over ssh
  fav version               print the version
  fav install-skill         install the /fav skill into Claude and Codex
  fav uninstall-skill       remove the /fav skill (only the symlinks)
  fav install-hook          let Claude Code tell fav when it asks you something (hooks in settings.json; fav uninstall-hook removes them)
  fav shell-init [zsh|bash] [--key ctrl-g] [--ui fzf|tui]  print shell code binding a key to fav fzf: put eval "$(fav shell-init zsh)" in .zshrc

Query: #tag project:x provider:claude status:open|active|done|archived|trash|all|live|agent
       after:2026-09-01 before:… last:7d turns:3 file:path host:<name>|all plus plain keywords (AND)
       <id> may be <host>:<id> for a configured host (show / preview / resume)
